g.title: catch22
g.text: 13 · Catch-22s: constraints that pull against each other
and the escape hatch chosen for each

g.title: a2
g.text: Only an operator who knows the real

g.title: a4
g.text: ack leaves it reported on every run

g.title: b3
g.text: state dir default outside it; exit 5 on overlap

g.title: b2
g.text: State dir must not overlap workspace

g.title: c3
g.text: planned: stdin/tty approver, 300 s timeout → deny,

g.title: d1
g.text: Any effect above B0 must be journaled first

g.title: d3
g.text: strict decoders; move-aside procedure, no auto-migrate

g.title: e3
g.text: Escape: AppArmor profile for bwrap (CI uses the sysctl);
else exit 3 — never silently run on host;

g.title: f1
g.text: Released flock proves the harness died

g.title: f2
g.text: …not that its children or remote effects stopped
